objective: Project candidate/exam/synthesis progress from durable RETURN evidence only, as an existing rich-response experiment_stats widget. Never infer liveness from prepared cards, ACTIVE/PARKED labels or target counts.

source_rules.candidates: unique durable candidate return_ref + worker_id + ordinal
source_rules.exams: unique durable exam return_ref + worker_id + ordinal
source_rules.synthesis: one durable final response/return evidence flag

truth_boundary: This projection reports durable completion counts, not live worker presence or background execution.
